harlenn_10.m: Well, yes. But just killing them won't have any effect. We have tried that, to no avail. They just keep coming back.

harlenn_11.m: You sound like my kind of type!

harlenn_12.m: Gornaud? I haven't heard about those. But I'm sure they couldn't possibly be worse than these beasts up here.

harlenn_13.m: Anyway, the beasts are really starting to cut down our numbers. But they are not our only concern.

harlenn_14.m: On top of that, we are being attacked by raids from those bastards down in that low-life town of Prim at the base of the mountain.

r: I talked to Guthbered in Prim. They say you are the ones doing the attacks, and that you are behind the gornaud attacks on Prim.
Is there anything I can do to help?

harlenn_16.m: They come here at night and sabotage our supplies.

harlenn_17.m: We are almost certain they are the ones behind these monsters also.
r: I talked to Guthbered in Prim. They say you are the ones doing the attacks, and that you are behind the gornaud attacks on Prim.
Is there anything I can do to help?

harlenn_18.m: Why, yes. Of course. If you are up to it.

harlenn_19.m: Considering you made it up here alive, I'm pretty sure you can handle yourself.

harlenn_2.m: You must be the newcomer that I heard about that traveled up the mountainside.

harlenn_20.m: OK, this is the plan. I want you to go talk to Guthbered down in Prim, and give him our ultimatum:

harlenn_21.m: Either they stop their attacks, or we will have to deal with them.
r: Sure. I will go tell him your ultimatum.
No. In fact, I think I should help the people of Prim instead.

harlenn_22.m: Good. Now hurry! We don't know how much time we have left before they attack again.

harlenn_3.m: We need your help in dealing with some ... problems.

harlenn_4.m: Oh sorry, I did not introduce myself properly. I am Harlenn, battle master of the people living in this mountain settlement.
r: I was told to see you by the guide that led me up the mountain.

harlenn_5.m: Oh yes, we are lucky he found you. You see, we seldom travel that far down the mountain.

harlenn_6.m: We spend most of our time in the settlement up here on the mountain.

harlenn_7.m: However, recent events have forced us to send for help. We are lucky you found us.
r: What problems are you referring to?

harlenn_8.m: I am sure you noticed just by getting here. The monsters of course!

harlenn_9.m: Those damn beasts outside our very settlement. The white wyrms and the aulaeth, and their trainers are even deadlier.
r: Those? They were no match for me.
I can see where this is going. You need me to deal with them for you I guess?
At least they aren't anything like those gornaud beasts at the bottom of the mountain.

harlenn_completed.m: Thank you, friend. Your help is greatly appreciated. Everyone in the Blackwater mountain settlement will want to talk to you now.

harlenn_completed_1.m: I'm sure the monster attacks will stop now when we kill the last few monsters that are outside the settlement.

harlenn_killguth_1.m: Hello again. Have you gotten rid of that lying Guthbered down in Prim?
r: Not yet, but I am working on it.
What was I supposed to do again?

harlenn_killguth_2.m: Ha ha! He is finally gone! Now we can rest comfortably in our settlement.

harlenn_killguth_3.m: They will no longer attack us now that their lying leader is gone!

harlenn_killguth_4.m: Thank you friend. Here, have these items as a token of our appreciation for your help.

harlenn_lookforsigns_1.m: Hello again. Did you find any clues in Prim that they are planning to attack us?
r: Yes. I found plans that they are recruiting mercenaries and will attack your settlement.
What was I supposed to do again?

harlenn_lookforsigns_10.m: You saw the plans yourself. They are going to attack us if we don't do something about them. Of course we have to kill him!
r: I will remove him, but I will try to find a peaceful solution to this.
Very well. He is as good as dead.

harlenn_lookforsigns_11.m: Excellent. Return to me once the deed is done.

harlenn_lookforsigns_12.m: Fine. Do whatever you need to remove him, but I don't want to deal with their attacks anymore.

harlenn_lookforsigns_2.m: Keep looking. I am sure they are planning something wicked.

harlenn_lookforsigns_3.m: I knew it! I knew they were up to something.

harlenn_lookforsigns_5.m: Anyway, thank you for your help in finding this evidence.

harlenn_lookforsigns_6.m: This calls for drastic measures. We have to act quickly before they can have time to complete their plan.

harlenn_lookforsigns_7.m: An old saying goes something like 'The only way to truly kill the Gorgon is by removing the head'. In this case, the head of those bastards down in Prim is that fellow Guthbered.

harlenn_lookforsigns_8.m: We should do something about him. You have proven your worth so far. This will be your final assignment.

harlenn_lookforsigns_9.m: I want you to go ... deal ... with him. Guthbered. Preferably in the most painful and gruesome way you can think of.
r: Are you sure more violence will really solve this conflict?
He is as good as dead.

harlenn_prim_1.m: We?! Hah! It figures he would say that. They are always lying and cheating to get things their way. We have certainly not attacked them!

harlenn_prim_2.m: It is, of course, *they* who are the ones causing all the trouble.

harlenn_prim_3.m: They even captured one of our fellow scouts. Who knows what they have done to him.

harlenn_prim_4.m: I'm telling you, they are treacherous and lying!
r: Sure, I believe you. What do you need from me?
What would I gain by helping you instead of them?
I'm not buying this. I think I would rather help the people of Prim than you people.

harlenn_prim_5.m: Gain? Our trust of course. You would always be welcome here in our camp. Our traders have some excellent equipment.
r: OK, I'll help you deal with them.
I'm still not convinced, but I'll help you for now.

harlenn_prim_6.m: Good. We will need an able fighter to help us deal with the monsters and the Prim bandits.

harlenn_prim_7.m: Bah. Then you are useless to me. Why did you even bother to come up here and waste my time? Begone.

harlenn_return_1.m: You again? I want no business with you. Leave me.
r: Why are you people attacking the village of Prim?

harlenn_return_2.m: Welcome back, traveller. What's on your mind?
r: I talked to Guthbered in Prim. They say you are attacking Prim, and that you are behind the gornaud attacks on Prim.
What was that you said earlier about the monsters that are attacking your settlement?

harlenn_return_3.m: Welcome back, traveller. Did you talk to that deceiving Guthbered down in Prim?
r: What was I supposed to do again?
Yes, I talked to him. He denies that they are behind any of the attacks.
I talked to Guthbered in Prim. They say you are the ones doing the attacks, and that you are behind the gornaud attacks on Prim.

harlenn_sentbyprim_1.m: Your expression tells me you have blood on your mind.
r: I am sent by the people of Prim to stop you.
I am sent by the people of Prim to stop you. However, I have decided not to kill you.

harlenn_sentbyprim_2.m: Stop me?! Ha ha. Very well, let's see who is the one being stopped here.

r: It's obvious that this conflict will only end in more bloodshed. That should stop here.
My proposal is that you leave this settlement and find a new home somewhere else.

harlenn_sentbyprim_5.m: Now why would I want to do that?
r: These two towns will always fight each other. By you leaving, they will think they have won, and stop their attacks.

harlenn_sentbyprim_6.m: Hmm, you might have a point there.

harlenn_sentbyprim_7.m: OK, you have convinced me. I will leave this settlement for another to find my home. The survival of my people here is more important than me.

harlenn_sentbyprim_8.m: Thank you friend, for talking some sense into me.

harlenn_talkedto_guth_1.m: He denies it?! Bah, that treacherous fool. I should have known that he wouldn't dare tell the truth.

harlenn_talkedto_guth_10.m: I want you to go investigate Prim for any signs that you might find of them preparing an attack on us.

harlenn_talkedto_guth_11.m: Good. Try not to be seen. You should go look for any clues around where that deceiving Guthbered stays.

harlenn_talkedto_guth_2.m: I am still sure that they somehow are behind all these attacks on us. Who else could there be? There are no other settlements around here for quite a walk.

harlenn_talkedto_guth_3.m: Besides, they have always been treacherous. No, of course they are behind the attacks.

harlenn_talkedto_guth_4.m: OK, this leaves us with no choice. We will have to step this up to another level.

harlenn_talkedto_guth_5.m: Are you sure you are up to it? You are not one of their spies are you? If you are working for them, then you should know that they are not to be trusted!
r: I am ready for anything. I will help your settlement.
Actually, now that you mention it...
Yes, I am working for Prim also. They seem like sensible people.

harlenn_talkedto_guth_6.m: What? Are you working for them or not?
r: No, never mind. I am ready to help your settlement.
I was. But I have decided to help you instead.
Yes. I am helping them get rid of you people.

harlenn_talkedto_guth_8.m: We believe they are planning to attack us any day now. But we lack the proof that we would need to do anything about it.

harlenn_talkedto_guth_9.m: This is where I think an outsider like you might help.

harlenn_workingforprim_1.m: My scouts have given me a most interesting report. They say you are working for Prim.

harlenn_workingforprim_2.m: Of course we can't have that here. We can't have a spy in our midst. You should leave our settlement while you still can, traitor.

bwm_agent.1: I met a man seeking help for his settlement, the 'Blackwater mountain'. Supposedly, his settlement is being attacked by monsters and bandits, and they need help from the outside.
bwm_agent.5: I have agreed to help the man and Blackwater mountain in dealing with the problem.
bwm_agent.10: The man told me to meet him on the other side of the collapsed mine. He will crawl through the mine shaft and I will descend into the pitch-black abandoned mine.
bwm_agent.20: I have navigated through the pitch-black abandoned mine, and met the man on the other side. He seemed very anxious about telling me to head straight to the east once I exit the mine. I should meet the man at the bottom of the mountain to the east.
bwm_agent.25: I heard a story about Prim and the Blackwater mountain settlement fighting against each other.
bwm_agent.30: I should follow the mountain path up the mountain to the Blackwater mountain settlement.
bwm_agent.40: I met the man again on my way up to Blackwater mountain. I should proceed further up the mountain.
bwm_agent.50: I have made it up to the snow-filled parts of the Blackwater mountain. The man told me to proceed further up the mountain. Apparently, the Blackwater mountain settlement is close by.
bwm_agent.60: I have reached the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should find and talk to their battle master, Harlenn.
bwm_agent.65: I have spoken to Harlenn in the Blackwater mountain settlement. Apparently, the settlement is under attack by a number of monsters, the aulaeth and white wyrms. On top of that, they are being attacked by the people of Prim.
bwm_agent.66: Harlenn thinks the people of Prim are behind the monster attacks somehow.
bwm_agent.70: Harlenn wants me to give a message to Guthbered of Prim. Either the people of Prim stop their attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement, or they will have to be dealt with themselves. I should go talk to Guthbered in Prim.
bwm_agent.80: Guthbered denies that the people of Prim have anything to do with the monster attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn.
bwm_agent.90: Harlenn is sure that the people of Prim are behind the attacks somehow.
bwm_agent.95: Harlenn wants me to go to Prim and look for signs that they are preparing for an attack on the settlement. I should go look for clues around where Guthbered stays.
bwm_agent.100: I have found some plans in Prim about recruiting mercenaries and attacking the Blackwater mountain settlement. I should go talk to Harlenn immediately.
bwm_agent.110: Harlenn thanked me for investigating the attack plans.
bwm_agent.120: To make the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement stop, Harlenn wants me to assassinate Guthbered in Prim.
bwm_agent.130: I have started a fight with Guthbered.
bwm_agent.131: I told Guthbered that I was sent to kill him, but I let him live. He thanked me deeply, and left Prim.
bwm_agent.149: I have told Harlenn that Guthbered is gone.
bwm_agent.150: Harlenn thanked me for the help I have provided. Hopefully, the attacks on the Blackwater mountain settlement should stop now.
bwm_agent.240: I am now trusted in the Blackwater mountain settlement, and all services should be available for me to use.
bwm_agent.250: I have decided to not help the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement.
bwm_agent.251: Since I am helping Prim, Harlenn no longer wants to talk to me.

prim_hunt.10: Just outside the collapsed mine on the way to Blackwater mountain, I met a man from the village of Prim. He begged me to help them.
prim_hunt.11: The village of Prim needs help from someone from the outside to deal with attacks from some monsters. I should speak to Guthbered in Prim if I want to help them.
prim_hunt.15: Guthbered can be found in the main hall of Prim. I should look for a stone house in the center of town.
prim_hunt.20: I talked to Guthbered about the story about Prim. Prim has recently been under constant attack from the Blackwater mountain settlement.
prim_hunt.25: Guthbered wants me to go up to the settlement atop the Blackwater mountain and ask their battle master Harlenn why (or if) they have summoned the gornaud monsters against Prim.
prim_hunt.30: I have talked to Harlenn about the attacks on Prim. He denies that the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement have anything to do with them. I should go talk to Guthbered in Prim again.
prim_hunt.40: Guthbered still believes that the people in the Blackwater mountain settlement have something to do with the attacks.
prim_hunt.50: Guthbered wants me to go look for any clues that the people of the Blackwater mountain settlement is preparing for a larger attack on Prim. I should go look for hints near Harlenn's private quarters, but make sure not to be seen.
prim_hunt.60: I have found some papers around Harlenn's private quarters outlining a plan to attack Prim. I should go talk to Guthbered immediately.
prim_hunt.70: Guthbered thanked me for helping him find evidence of the plans for an attack.
prim_hunt.80: In order to make the attacks on Prim stop, Guthbered wants me to kill Harlenn up in the Blackwater mountain settlement.
prim_hunt.90: I have started a fight with Harlenn.
prim_hunt.91: I told Harlenn that I was sent to kill him, but I let him live. He thanked me deeply, and left the settlement.
prim_hunt.99: I have told Guthbered that Harlenn is gone.
prim_hunt.100: Guthbered thanked me for the help I have provided to Prim. Hopefully, the attacks on Prim should stop now. As thanks, Guthbered gave me some items and a forged permit so that I can enter the inner chamber up in the Blackwater mountain settlement.
prim_hunt.140: I have shown the forged permit to the guard and was let through to the inner chamber.
prim_hunt.240: I am now trusted in Prim, and all services should be available for me to use.
prim_hunt.250: I have decided to not help the people of Prim.
prim_hunt.251: Since I am helping the Blackwater mountain settlement, Guthbered no longer wants to talk to me.
